search_text: published ZDI-25-385 ZDI-CAN-25923 Siemens TeleControl Server Basic RestoreFromBackup SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2025-06-16 CVE-2025-29905 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-29905 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Siemens'] ['TeleControl Server Basic'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Siemens TeleControl Server Basic. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the RestoreFromBackup method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of NETWORK SERVICE. Siemens has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Siemens TeleControl Server Basic RestoreFromBackup SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Siemens TeleControl Server Basic. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the RestoreFromBackup method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of NETWORK SERVICE.
